title: Brittany Schmitt DESTROYS Modern Dating 😂 | Sorry Dad (Full Special)
description:
Brittany Schmitt: Sorry Dad is a fearless, brutally funny stand-up comedy special packed with hilarious stories, dark humor, and brutally honest observations about modern life.

Fresh off a divorce, Brittany Schmitt dives headfirst into the chaos of dating in your 30s—from sugar daddy websites and tiny professional athletes to therapy disasters and unforgettable family moments. Blending sharp storytelling with emotional honesty, Sorry Dad is equal parts relatable, outrageous, and laugh-out-loud funny.

If you're a fan of comedians like Nikki Glaser, Taylor Tomlinson, Whitney Cummings, Iliza Shlesinger, Christina P, or Sarah Silverman, this comedy special is a must-watch.

🎤 About Brittany Schmitt
Known for her bold storytelling, quick wit, and fearless stage presence, Brittany Schmitt delivers an unforgettable hour of stand-up comedy that mixes personal experiences with dark, clever humor.
